label: Q01
question: S_qual holds 253 distinct values with a dense 256-271 cluster, where every other quality column has 3-10. Is this a bitmask (256 + low nibble)?
context: Harvested from the Access hydrographic master (Bottle_Q, 909,076 rows). Until resolved, salinity quality cannot be interpreted and any salinity QC rule would be built on sand. See metadata/calcofi/hydro-master/questions.csv hydro_master_02b.

label: Q02
question: Only quality codes 6, 8 and 9 are documented, but T_qual uses 0-7 and P_qual uses 3/5/7. What do the undocumented codes mean?
context: metadata/measurement_qual.csv documents 3 codes (6 = data OK but taken from CTD, 8 = suspect, 9 = missing) plus 7 observed-but-undocumented single-digit codes; qual_code_observed.csv holds 279 column/code pairs, 248 with code > 9. measurement_qual is currently an uninterpreted pass-through.

label: Q03
question: In 2014 only 3.2% of ammonium values are zero, against 41% in 2013 and 53% in 2015. Were 2014 values not zeroed at the detection limit?
context: Ammonium is left-censored: code 4 = 'value zeroed due to value below detection limit'. The 2014 discontinuity appears in BOTH the bottle table and the CTD-embedded copy, so it is a real feature of that year's reporting rather than a product difference. Any trend fitted through 2014 is distorted. See calcofi.io/workflows/explore_ctd-cast.html

label: Q04
question: 24,579 ammonium values are exactly zero but carry no quality flag, all before 2014. Should the below-detection flag be backfilled?
context: The qual=4 flag is essentially unused before 2013 (0-0.9%) yet exact zeros already run 40-71% in 2008-2012, converging with the flag only after 2015. Filtering on the flag therefore removes ~0% of the early record and ~75% of the late record, manufacturing a trend from a bookkeeping change. Until backfilled, the portable censoring test is measurement_value == 0, not the flag.

label: Q05
question: Confirm the intended relationship between the QC'd ammonia and the pre-QC r_ammonium series.
context: Both are registered canonical and both report near-identical below-detection fractions by year (e.g. 53.4% vs 53.4% in 2015), so the QC step appears not to change the censoring. Knowing whether r_ammonium is meant to be published at all would let us drop or document it.

label: Q06
question: Which cast/bottle records were withdrawn after the published extract was generated, and should they be treated as retracted?
context: Reconciliation against the Access master found 85 bottles deleted from the master after the export (cruises 202105/202111/202208/202211) and 93 mid-import rows for 202304. None leaked into the release, but a standing rule would make future extracts self-checking.
